title: Holo Nave Liturgy
description: A reference-dependent series: one master gothic nave establishes the hologram liturgy look, and three liturgical-moment variations reuse the same architecture while changing projection color, crowd, and time of day.
creative_direction: Reference image 01 locks the nave geometry, rib-vault direction, column spacing, and holographic rose window position. Images 02-04 depend on 01 as --ref and replay the same symmetric aisle through three liturgical moods while preserving architectural identity.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-04. Queue may run 02-04 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
